about.headline: A long-term enterprise built for lasting impact.
about.body: PT. Trishanti Sinergi Indocorp was founded on the belief that a diversified enterprise, built with purpose and discipline, can create lasting value for people, communities, and the nation. We are not a single-product company — we are a family of businesses united by one vision: a brighter tomorrow, together.
